chart.name: Shared memory operations
chart.programText: A = data('total_operations.*', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish') and filter('plugin_instance', '*-shm'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['sf_metric']).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Connection states
chart.programText: A = data('connections.*', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish') and filter('plugin_instance', '*-backend'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['sf_metric']).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Total request bytes
chart.programText:
A = data('total_bytes.req_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('total_bytes.req_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: VCL on host
chart.programText:
A = data('vcl.total_vcl', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='A')
B = data('vcl.avail_vcl', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='B')
C = data('vcl.discarded_vcl', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Total response bytes
chart.programText:
A = data('total_bytes.resp_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('total_bytes.resp_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Uptime
chart.programText:
A = data('uptime.client_uptime', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).mean().publish(label='A')
B = (A/(60*60*24)).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Cache results/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('cache_result.hit', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='A')
B = data('cache_result.miss', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B')
C = data('cache_result.hitpass', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Bytes/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('total_bytes.resp_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('total_bytes.resp_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).publish(label='C')
D = data('total_bytes.req_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = data('total_bytes.req_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (D+E).publish(label='F')

chart.name: Session operations/sec
chart.programText: A = data('total_operations.*', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish') and filter('plugin_instance', '*-session'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['sf_metric']).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Backend count
chart.programText: A = data('backends.n_backends', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Bytes/request
chart.programText:
A = data('total_bytes.resp_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('total_bytes.resp_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
G = data('connections.received', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').mean().publish(label='G', enable=False)
C = ((A+B)/G).mean().publish(label='C')
D = data('total_bytes.req_body', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = data('total_bytes.req_header', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = ((D+E)/G).mean().publish(label='F')

chart.name: # Worker threads
chart.programText: A = data('threads.worker', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Connections received
chart.programText: A = data('connections.received', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')

chart.name: Cache hit rate %
chart.programText:
A = data('cache_result.hit', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cache_result.miss', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/(A+B)*100).mean(over='1m').publish(label='C')

chart.name: Total connection rate/sec
chart.programText: A = data('connections.received', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A')

chart.name: # Servers
chart.programText: A = data('uptime.client_uptime', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).sum(by=['host']).count().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Hit rate %
chart.programText:
A = data('cache_result.hit', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cache_result.miss', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/(A+B) * 100).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('cache_result.hitpass', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish'), rollup='rate').sum(by=['host']).publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (C).min().publish(label='E')
F = (C).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='F')
G = (C).max().publish(label='G')

chart.name: Worker thread distribution
chart.programText:
D = data('threads.worker', filter=filter('plugin', 'varnish')).publish(label='D', enable=False)
A = (D).min().publish(label='A')
B = (D).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='B')
C = (D).max().publish(label='C')
